messages:
anya: Customer escalated — API returned invalid JSON when using json_mode=structured. Downstream parser fails with 'unexpected token'. They attached the response body and say it happens intermittently. X-Request-ID: r-7f4c. Any quick ideas?

sam: Can you paste the exact response body and the request headers/model info? Also was this streaming or non-streaming?

anya: Here's the exact response body they sent: 
```json
[{"id":123,"name":"Alice"},{"id":null,"note":"truncated"},{"id":124,"name":"Bob","debug":true}]
```
They say sometimes items are missing the 'name' key and sometimes an extra 'debug' key appears. Call was non-streaming (streaming=false), json_mode=structured, schema expects every item to have id (non-null) and name. Repro steps included in customer message.

ellie: :eyes: When did this start? Any recent model or runtime rollout in the region? We should also get the full response headers and X-Request-ID.

anya: Happened ~2024-06-10 14:02 UTC. Headers they reported: 
```
content-type: application/json
x-request-id: r-7f4c
transfer-encoding: chunked
```
Response body is exactly the JSON above.

mike: Two quick hypotheses: 1) generator emitted partial/truncated object due to a token cutoff, 2) schema drift — model variant added extra keys. Even though streaming=false, runtime could still chunk under the hood. Escalating to eng-runtime. In the meantime, can the customer try max_tokens=2048?

sam: Also note we validate strictly by default: extra keys will cause rejection in strict schema mode. There's a known workaround flag allow_extra_keys=true in our SDK that accepts unknown fields. Recommend trying that as a temporary workaround.

anya: They tried allow_extra_keys already — still saw parse errors when id is null. Error shows 'required field id missing' even though id key exists but value is null. Their downstream system treats null as missing.

ellie: That suggests our validator treats null as equivalent to missing for required non-null fields. Escalating for clarification on validation semantics. @eng-runtime / @eng-ml — can you confirm whether model outputs can legitimately emit null for required fields?

mike: infra-bot created incident ticket IR-2024-873 and attached runtime logs and the customer's sample. Logs show the model emitted a complete chunk with a null id: 
```
[runtime] 2024-06-10T14:02:05Z model=redwood-v1 emit_chunk="{\"id\":null,\"note\":\"truncated\"}"
[runtime] 2024-06-10T14:02:05Z chunk_end
```
So it appears the generator produced a null id value as part of a syntactically valid object.

sam: For support repro, recommended steps: 1) call the endpoint with the customer's prompt, 2) set max_tokens=2048, temperature=0.0, 3) try json_mode.strict=false and allow_extra_keys=true. If that parses, it's a validation strictness issue. If it still fails, we need a runtime dump.

anya: Customer prompt (redacted): "Return a JSON array of user profiles with id, name, email, and preferences. If a profile is incomplete, include a note." I'll run repro with the flags and report back.

mike: FYI: billing/ops note — repeated retries can cause quota and billing spikes for the customer. Recommend advising the customer to pause retries and let us investigate. Also check their org quota around the times listed.

ellie: Quick engineering patch idea: parser could optionally drop array items where required non-null fields are null (configurable), rather than failing hard. That would be a less breaking fallback for some customers. I'll open a PR for a configurable null-handling option if runtime confirms nulls are being emitted.

anya: Thanks — I'll run the repro and update here. :thumbsup: If eng-runtime confirms model variant started adding 'debug' key, we should add it to our schema mapping or update redwood-verified model profiles.

sam: Adding checklist for support handoff: paste full failing response (body + headers), include X-Request-ID, attach sample prompt & client code, try allow_extra_keys and json_mode.strict=false, and include whether the client treats null as missing.

anya: Posted all that to the ticket IR-2024-873. Will follow up after repro.

infra-bot: Incident IR-2024-873 created and assigned to eng-runtime. Logs attached.

mike: Thanks team — keep the thread for updates. If we confirm runtime emitted nulls, we should classify as production regression and prioritize.

anya: Will update. Thanks everyone.
